abstract: The authors reported the intraperitoneal carcinomatosis after laparoscopic surgery for presumably benign ruptured ovarian teratoma in a 28-year-old woman. A 28-year-old female patient exhibited intraperitoneal carcinomatosis after a laparoscopic surgery for ruptured mature teratoma of the ovary with occult malignant transformation. The complication was found two months after initial laparoscopic surgery. Laparoscopic surgery was smooth including oophorectomy, and removing all spilled specimens within the abdominal cavity. At the end of the laparoscopic surgery, cleaning the abdominal cavity and irritating the port site were also performed. Cytology of the abdominal cavity and all removed specimens did not show evidence of malignancy. She followed up regularly and uneventfully except for persistently abdominal fullness and erythematous change of umbilical portal site. Evidence demonstrated intestinal obstruction associated with ascites after a detailed evaluation. Although the patient received supportive treatment the symptom exacerbated. Therefore, the patient was treated with exploratory laparotomy. Pathology proved with intraperitoneal carcinomatosis caused by squamous cell carcinoma. All tumor evaluations including tumor markers, a thorough physical examination, imaging studies and evaluations of the nuclear medicine were negative except of intraperitoneal carcinoma, origin to be determined. The patient is dead 14 months' post-treatment by exploratory laparotomy. Although it was not clear that the laparoscopic approach or the disease itself worsened indeed the prognosis because the disease was already disseminated before the laparoscopy, we still emphasized the possible limitation of laparoscopic surgery if diagnosis at original surgery is impaired, of if excision is incomplete and the delay between the laparoscopic procedure and the carcinomatosis.
abstract_ja: 著者らは、良性と考えられた破裂卵巣奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡手術後に腹膜播種性癌腫症を発症した症例を報告する。28歳女性が、潜在性の悪性転化を伴う破裂成熟卵巣奇形腫に対して腹腔鏡下手術を受けた。手術は、卵巣摘出術と腹腔内にこぼれた検体すべての除去を含め、円滑に行われた。手術終了時には腹腔内の洗浄とポート部位の処置も行われた。腹腔内および切除検体の細胞診に悪性所見はなかった。合併症は初回の腹腔鏡手術から2か月後に判明した。患者は定期的に経過観察を受けたが、腹部膨満感と臍部ポート部位の紅斑が持続した以外は問題がなかった。詳細な評価により、腸閉塞と腹水が認められた。支持療法を受けたが症状は悪化した。そのため開腹術が施行された。病理検査で扁平上皮癌による腹膜播種性癌腫症と確認された。腫瘍マーカー、身体所見、画像検査、核医学検査はいずれも、原発不明の腹膜癌腫以外は陰性であった。患者は開腹術後14か月で死亡した。播種性疾患は腹腔鏡手術前にすでに広がっていたため、腹腔鏡手術または疾患そのものが予後を悪化させたかは明らかではない。しかし、初回手術時の診断が不十分な場合、切除が不完全な場合、または腹腔鏡手術と癌腫症の発症までに間隔がある場合には、腹腔鏡手術の限界があることを強調したい。
